title: Student Worker
bio: ​​Tammy Lee (she/her) is a junior at Harvard College in Eliot House (Prescotts) concentrating in Sociology and East Asian Studies, with a secondary in Government. Originally from Los Angeles, CA, Tammy is a proud Korean American raised by a single mother who draws on her lived experience as a first-generation, low-income student in her work on campus. At Harvard, she has directed PBHA’s Southie After School program, supported incoming students through the Harvard First-Year Retreat and Experience (FYRE), and written for The Harvard Crimson . Tammy is passionate about building inclusive communities and hopes her work with the Harvard Foundation will help cultivate spaces where students from all backgrounds feel seen, heard, and valued.
